name: Mara's Bread Counter
purpose: A small shop with counted bread stock, a pickup counter and room to queue off the public crossing.
route: Prepared bread arrives from UG-12 through UG-08 to UG-03; this counter has no industrial oven or new exhaust shaft.
public: Front of house and pickup counter. Stock and handwash nook are staff space.
story: A promised order competes with Mara's capacity. A correction is visible on the order slate.
permanent: South entrance centered on the bay
Counter behind a clear customer zone
state: Daily bread, order slate, staff shift, returned baskets

name: Repair & Tool Loan
purpose: A neighborhood handoff point for small repairs and loan tools. Large or hazardous work goes to BRW-07.
route: Goods arrive through ordinary commons routes. No direct workshop tunnel is added.
public: Ticket counter, safe display and pickup. Bench and tool storage are supervised.
story: Tavi must admit a repair is not ready. An honestly delayed handoff preserves trust.
state: Repair tickets, loan tags, active project, staff shift

name: Pantry & Produce
purpose: A measured neighborhood supply shop for fresh produce, dry staples and household containers.
route: Supplies come from BRW-10, UG-18, surface gardens and UG-13 using recorded routes and receiving handoffs.
public: Display and counter. The covered stock zone is staff space.
story: A delivery mismatch delays one meal or job; it does not instantly starve the town.
state: Stock quantities, labels, delivery tags, substitute goods

name: Jun's Mending Room
purpose: Mending, fitting and small sign work, with a clear private fitting area and visible pickup rack.
route: Ordinary street access only. Materials move by cart; no new wall opening connects adjacent shops.
public: Consultation table and pickup. Fitting privacy is controlled by the person using it.
story: A visible repair becomes something a resident values instead of something Jun has to hide.
state: Cloth rolls, appointment cards, repairs and posted signs

name: Learning Room One
purpose: One of the four already allocated learning rooms, for a flexible group of about 16 learners. Other rooms and shifts share the school demand.
route: South door enters the school's central circulation strip, then the existing west connection to UG-08.
public: Classroom access follows the teaching schedule; guardians and visitors check in with staff.
story: A group redesigns a confusing wayfinding card. Each learner contributes a different observation.
permanent: South entry and clear central aisle
West materials and east reading corner
state: Desk groupings, lesson materials, projects, attendance

name: Care Room One
purpose: A private assessment and recovery room within the already allocated clinic zone, with a quiet waiting position and handwash point.
route: South door meets the care hall's central circulation, separate from the kitchen and food handling.
public: Entry by invitation or a care handoff. Personal records are not visible from the corridor.
story: An exhausted helper accepts rest and asks someone else to finish a job.
state: Occupancy, screen position, supplies and care handoff

name: Lantern Street Home 001
purpose: A compact 48 m2 household home within the southwest frontage of the northwest court. It is one of the ward's 100 planned homes, not an extra unit.
route: South door opens onto the ward's existing central street. No private route reaches the surface or another level.
public: The doorstep faces a public gallery; the interior requires the household's permission. Occupants are intentionally not assigned yet.
story: A private household moment shows why a shared town matters. The heroes are guests, not owners of every room.
permanent: West wash compartment and service wall
state: Household assignment, furniture, decoration and ordinary wear
